sentences.text: Sea Building Oy is a company registered on 2026-03-25 under the industry code 41000, construction of buildings.
A start-up notification and a board change were registered on 2026-03-29, first sales are recorded on 2026-07-15 and a first hire on 2026-10-01.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the name contains a sea word but the registered industry is building construction and the record shows no ocean use.
